title: Hands-on: Your first conversation with an AI assistant
body:
🛠 Hands-on exercise

Open any AI chat assistant and try three things:

  1. Ask it to explain a concept you already understand well. Notice how it structures the explanation.
  2. Ask the exact same question twice. Compare the two answers — what stays the same and what varies?
  3. Ask something slightly unusual ("give me 5 unusual uses for a paperclip") and see how it handles open-ended creative tasks.

Pay attention to tone, structure, and confidence. You'll build on these first impressions throughout the course.
